title: Tobacco Road Zimbabwe (Mbira Folk)
style: Zimbabwean mbira folk urban grooves acoustic guitar hosho shakers ngoma drums warm baritone 82bpm analog tape warm storytelling Shona heritage farm history tobacco
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The tobacco road ran from the barn down to the lower gate
Where the trucks came in the harvest season early and late
The leaves were hung in rows to dry in long amber patience
The smell of curing tobacco is the smell of those locations

[Chorus]
Tobacco road, tobacco road
Running through the memory of everything we had and owed
Tobacco road, tobacco road
The crop that fed the family in the season's heavy load
Tobacco road knows what the land was asked to give
Tobacco road knows what we gave it back to live

[Verse 2]
The workers knew the leaf before the grader knew the price
They sorted it by hand and that was not a task done twice in haste
The grading shed had its own system and its own language
And the tobacco road connected the whole language

[Bridge]
Now the tobacco crop is gone from most of those farms
And the grading sheds are empty with their empty opened arms
But the road remains — red dust and the msasa at the edge
And the tobacco road remembers every promise and its pledge

[Outro]
Tobacco road knows… the farm remembers… the dust holds it…
The gardens still growing
